scope: Journal-based crash diagnosis, static binary inspection, synthetic native regression tests and bounded live deployment verification
repair: When both named peers exist and either owner fails the pipeline class check, use stock base dismantle and skip optional pipe merging
limitations: No player dismantle action had exercised the installed guard at the recorded check
Journal confirms a null interface argument; the identity and original cause of the failed owner cast remain unobserved
Raw production logs are private and excluded because they contain player authentication material
Health checks from the LAN do not prove reachability through every external network or client
